text: Let Everything That Has Breath Praise the LORD

segments.text:
Hallelujah!
Praise God in His sanctuary. Praise Him in His mighty heavens.

footnotes.text: + Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 6
+ Or in the expanse of his might or in the firmament of his might; see also Genesis 1:6–8.

segments.text: Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him for His excellent greatness.
Praise Him with the sound of the horn; praise Him with the harp and lyre.
Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; praise Him with strings and flute.
Praise Him with clashing cymbals; praise Him with resounding cymbals.

Let everything that has breath praise the LORD!
Hallelujah!
